import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Get coordinates for station 14 (Mong Kok)
station_query = text("""
SELECT id, name_en, coordinate::geography
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 14
""")
station_df = pd.read_sql(station_query, engine)
print("Station 14 coordinates:")
print(station_df[['id', 'name_en']])
print(f"Station 14 coordinate: {station_df['coordinate'].values[0]}")

# Step 2: Fetch all DECLARED_MONUMENT entities with their geometries
monument_query = text("""
SELECT id, name, geometry::geometry AS geom
FROM sensitive_area
WHERE category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
""")
monuments_df = pd.read_sql(monument_query, engine)
print(f"\nNumber of DECLARED_MONUMENT entities: {len(monuments_df)}")
print(monuments_df[['id', 'name']].head(10))

# Step 3: Calculate distance from station 14 to each monument centroid and find nearest
if len(monuments_df) > 0:
    station_coord = station_df['coordinate'].values[0]
    
    # Build a query to calculate distances using ST_Distance and ST_Centroid
    monument_distances_query = text("""
    SELECT sa.id, sa.name, 
           ST_Distance(
               sa.geometry::geography,
               ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography
           ) AS centroid_distance_from_self,
           ST_Distance(
               :station_coord::geography,
               ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography
           ) AS dist_to_station_m
    FROM sensitive_area sa
    WHERE sa.category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
    ORDER BY dist_to_station_m ASC
    LIMIT 10
    """)
    
    monument_distances_df = pd.read_sql(monument_distances_query, engine, params={'station_coord': station_coord})
    print("\nNearest monuments to station 14 (by centroid distance):")
    print(monument_distances_df[['name', 'dist_to_station_m']].head(10))
    
    # Get the nearest monument
    nearest = monument_distances_df.iloc[0]
    print(f"\nNearest monument: {nearest['name']}")
    print(f"Distance: {nearest['dist_to_station_m']} metres")

# Use %s for parameter binding with psycopg2

       ST_Distance(
           sa.geometry::geography,
           ST_Centroid(sa.geometry)::geography
       ) AS centroid_distance_from_self,

           %s::geography,

WHERE sa.category = 'DECLARED_MONUMENT'
